local_ctest.sequence: The full attempt passed 44 targets; two new stale-selection fixture rows tried to edit an already disabled canvas and hit their deadlines, causing the editor target timeout. The injection now uses the existing early QAction changed boundary; the complete editor target passes. Final visual hooks were verified by both complete affected dialog/open targets. Forty-two other successful targets retained; no timeout/expected result changed. This is not one final full run.

minimum_qt.sequence: Full attempt passed 44 targets; the same stale-selection fixture correction is verified by the complete final editor retest. Final dialog/open targets pass; 42 other successful targets retained. Minimum-Qt full builds pass.

new_native_cases.detail: Cancelled late success/exception; nonblocking close/child/owner teardown; frozen initial pixels/options, profile/alpha, borrowed-buffer release, redacted failure/retry; file/colour/source/confirmation picker teardown and cleanup; initial publication/reentry; immutable old session, early stale-selection refusal and standalone editor parents.

verification.visual_review: Inspected synthetic New Image dimensions/background ARGB/linear profile/initial controls/policy/Create/Cancel and Open progress/Cancel. Offscreen Qt widgets only; physical helpers and human a11y reviews remain Required.
verification.review_findings: New test includes were corrected; a new replacement fixture initially compared an untagged input QImage to the correctly sRGB-tagged output. It now asserts independent blue pixels, dimensions and selected sRGB profile. Stale-selection injection initially attempted a disabled canvas; moving it to the established early busy-notification boundary fixed the fixture and verifies actual refusal. Old no-result/history/file assertions remain. Private Qt pickers/QSettings replace unobservable offscreen theme-helper fixtures; production honors desktop helpers. No contracts, vectors or timeouts changed.
